output.summary: An annual vine native to Southern Africa, the horned melon bears spiny fruit with orange skin and soft, lime-green flesh when ripe. A traditional African food, the fruit may be eaten at any ripeness and is mainly served as a snack or salad in northern Zimbabwe.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit is eaten at any ripeness, mainly as a snack or salad in northern Zimbabwe; some people also eat the peel.
